slides.headline: So I met this cool person named Tanya and she invited me to do a podcast, so I did her
slides.body: So I met this cool person named Tanya and she invited me to do a podcast, so I did her podcast last week, it was published today. So today at GDC the Games Developer Conference I recorded another podcast with Tanya and a bunch of cool folks and I found out that the audience for her podcast is something like 17.5 Million people in the UK. We talked all about Virtual Reality, Science, Technology and Evolving Audiences, it was quite a fun podcast and I hope you give it a listen. It’s called Digital Jam Sessions http://digitaljamsessions.com/the-importance-of-evolving-audiences-for-vr-games
